scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx --watch apps/api/src/server.ts
scripts.demo:export: npm run build && node --env-file=runtime-data/demo.env apps/worker/dist/data-cli.js export
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env packages/database/dist/cli.js migrate
scripts.db:smoke: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env packages/database/dist/cli.js smoke
